The chart app has five components that render `ActionMenuButton2`, plus one test that mocks it. The framework definition is in `openmrs-esm-core`.

**Consumers in the patient chart (most affected first)**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket-action-button/order-basket-action-button.component.tsx:13-33` passes `tagContent` (the basket count) and `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch={startVisitIfNeeded}`, and sets `windowProps`. It is sensitive to changes in the count tag and the launch-callback contract.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/visit-note-action-button.extension.tsx:10-26` passes `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch={startVisitIfNeeded}` to launch `visit-notes-form-workspace`. A change to when the callback runs would affect whether a visit gets started.
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-forms-app/src/clinical-form-action-button.component.tsx:10-27` passes `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch={startVisitIfNeeded}` to launch `clinical-forms-workspace`.
4. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-lists-app/src/action-button/patient-lists-action-button.extension.tsx:5-17` uses only `icon`, `label` and `workspaceToLaunch`, so it is affected only by the core toggle behaviour (launch, restore or hide).
5. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-task-list-app/src/launch-button/task-list-launch-button.extension.tsx:5-18` uses only `icon`, `label` and `workspaceToLaunch`, so it is affected only by the core toggle behaviour.

**Test that would not catch a behaviour change**

6. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-forms-app/src/clinical-form-action-button.test.tsx:8-15` replaces `ActionMenuButton2` with a plain `<button>` mock, and the suite at `:26-49` only checks rendering by label. A behaviour change in the real component would pass these tests.

**Framework definition (the source of any behaviour change)**

7. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/workspaces2/action-menu2/action-menu-button2.component.tsx:66-143` holds the component and its toggle logic (hide, restore, or launch), plus the `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch` gate. That gate only runs when the window is not already open.

Outside the chart app, `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-ward-app/src/action-menu-buttons/` and related ward files also use it, but those are not part of the patient chart app, so I left them out.

Two notes on method: Falkon rejected the short repo names I passed (`openmrs-esm-core` and so on), so I used the `github.com/openmrs/...` form for core and read the chart files from the local checkout. I did not run the test suite.
